annotation.title_clean: Part 774—The Commerce Control List (15 CFR Part 774, including Supplement No. 1)
annotation.title_en: Part 774—The Commerce Control List (15 CFR Part 774, including Supplement No. 1)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bureau of Industry and Security, U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: US Export Administration Regulations' Commerce Control List, listing dual-use and military-related items (firearms, ammunition, military vehicles, software, technology, semiconductor equipment) by ECCN with licence requirements and exceptions. Not AI-specific; robots mentioned only as a cross-reference to ECCNs 0A606 and 2B007.
key_provisions_or_claims: BIS maintains the CCL listing items by ECCN with reasons for control and country-chart licence requirements.
Category 0 controls firearms, ammunition, and military ground vehicles, including unmanned ones, with licence exceptions limits.
600-series items face de minimis and foreign direct product reach under ECCN 0A919.
Robots and robot controllers are cross-referenced to USML Category VII and ECCNs 0A606 and 2B007.
Supplement 7 lists very sensitive items drawn from the Wassenaar Arrangement.
